title.zh: 通往 E3 之路 · 第 1 天

subtitle.en: With one week before E3, Luis Antonio posts a daily diary of the entry area coming together.
subtitle.zh: E3 前只剩一周，Luis Antonio 每天记录入口区域从草图到成型的过程。

translator.note: 原文 7 张图。原文里图片有时和文字连在同一段，译文按原顺序保留在同一段内；图片链接指向原文上传的最大尺寸原图。

blocks.en: Since we have only one week to get the entry area ready before E3 I was thinking it could be interesting to have a post at the end of each day to show how we are progressing.
blocks.zh: 因为我们只有一周时间把入口区域准备好迎接 E3，我想着每天结束时发一篇帖子、展示我们的进展，应该会挺有意思。

blocks.en: It will balance out the high programming post count we've had the past few days and hopefully show a bit of how the art team works!
blocks.zh: 这样也能平衡一下前几天帖子里编程内容占比过高的情况，顺便让大家看看美术团队是怎么干活的！

blocks.en: Last week, as you could see from previous screenshot, we got a rough layout of the area in the engine and tried to find answers to any remaining issues.
blocks.zh: 上周，正如之前的截图里能看到的那样，我们在引擎里搭出了这片区域的粗略布局，并试着为剩下的问题找到答案。

blocks.en: Today the goal was to sort out the design and navigation of the main entrance and the small towers.
blocks.zh: 今天的目标是理清主入口和几座小塔楼的设计与动线。

blocks.en: This is one of my first mockups that didn't look quite right.
blocks.zh: 这是我最早的一版草图，看着不太对。

blocks.en: The architects took a look at it and provided some 3d models of how castle stairs are usually assembled as well as sketches of how it should look:
blocks.zh: 建筑师看过后，给了一些展示城堡楼梯通常怎么拼装的 3D 模型，还有它应该长什么样的草图：

blocks.en: After, I tried to figure out the details from references and what "pieces" I would need to build the structure.
blocks.zh: 之后，我试着从参考资料里弄清细节，以及搭这个结构需要哪些「部件」。

blocks.en: Two years ago I went for vacations in Portugal and tried to see some castles. One of them in Guimaraes struck me as very similar to the entry yard. I made sure I got some pictures and now they are proving to be useful with angles that would be hard to get from online research.
blocks.zh: 两年前我去葡萄牙度假，顺便去看了几座城堡。Guimaraes 的那座让我觉得和这个入口庭院非常像。我当时特意拍了不少照片，现在它们派上用场了——里面有些角度在网上很难找到。

blocks.zh: 下面是使用不同的模块化楼梯/地板/城垛部件做出来的当前结果：

blocks.en: And the current overall look by the end of today:
blocks.zh: 以及今天收工时整体的样子：

blocks.en: Tomorrow I'll be tackling the rest of the exterior walls and the 3 other towers.
blocks.zh: 明天我会处理剩下的外墙，还有另外 3 座塔楼。
